description: This file defines a PHP class ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for managing reporting method configurations via REST API endpoints in the PIM module. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) and validation rules, using OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing ReportingMethod configurations within the PIM module, handling CRUD operations with validation and OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ReportingMethod configuration by ID, throws a not found exception if it does not exist.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all ReportingMethod configurations with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ReportingMethod configuration using provided data.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Internal method to create or update a ReportingMethod entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple ReportingMethod configurations based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching a single ReportingMethod by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing ReportingMethods with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new ReportingMethod, specifically the 'name' field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a ReportingMethod, validating ID and name.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForSaveReportingMethod
methods.description: Validation rules for saving a ReportingMethod entity, used internally.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting ReportingMethod entities, including checks for in-use IDs.
